OPEN MORNINGS FOR RECEPTION CLASS 2027
Prospective parents of children due to start school in September 2027 are warmly invited to come and learn about our lovely school on either:
Wednesday 4th November 2026 - 9.15am
Friday 13th November 2026 - 9.15am
There will be a presentation from Mrs Hodson, Headteacher, followed by a guided tour of the school led by Year 6. .
There is no need to pre book, just come along on your preferred day. These sessions will last approximately 1 hour
Children are very welcome to come with you.
We look forward to seeing you!
